name: Vision-R1-cold
description: A high-quality multimodal chain-of-thought dataset with 200K samples constructed without human annotations, designed to improve reasoning capabilities in multimodal large language models through reinforcement learning.
reputation: A recent multimodal reasoning dataset that has attracted interest in video-language research, especially for reinforcement-learning-based reasoning training.
notes: Dataset constructed via modality bridging and data filtering leveraging existing MLLMs; used for reinforcement learning to enhance multimodal math reasoning.
